Geographies Served Programs Integrated Self Development Centres District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra At Swa-Roopwardhinee, the Integrated Self Development Centres operate continuously, fostering regular engagement with beneficiary families. Various activities, including residential camps, trekking, and study tours, are organized to ensure holistic student development. Motivational training forms the core of these initiatives, leading to the recruitment of dedicated volunteers and inspiring some students to commit themselves to full-time social work. Mobile Laboratory Project District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra In the Mobile Laboratory Project initiated by Swa-Roopwardhinee, inspired by the late Shri. Kishabhau Patwardhan in 1994-95, volunteers reached out to village schools surrounding Pune City, offering science experiment demonstrations. The enthusiastic response highlights the lack of laboratory facilities in many of these schools. Operating in Mulshi & Haveli Tehesil, the project primarily benefits students from Std. 5th to 7th, aligning experiments with their science syllabus. Students are encouraged to actively participate in these hands-on activities, fostering a deeper understanding of scientific concepts. Additionally, special sessions cater to 10th Std. students in various village schools.
